instructions_to_main_agent: Use Javascript/React with React Router v7. Files must be .jsx/.js format as requested in the project configuration.
Implement structured accessible semantic HTML with high APCA contrast (>4.5:1 for body, >7:1 for headings).

Ensure all interactive items (buttons, mailto triggers, navigation links, filters, modals) have explicit data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='nav-link-services', data-testid='cta-contact-khushboo', data-testid='service-card-linkedin').
Use the crystal glass header with fixed z-50 and top padding on main content to avoid any overlap.
Integrate Lucide React icons cleanly without generic AI robot emojis.
Do not implement cookie banners or invasive trackers as per explicit user choice.
Provide a downloadable PDF preview/mock trigger modal or clean reference sheet on service pages.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.anti_ai_slop: Avoid generic centered cards, oversaturated gradients, and default template look. Use asymmetric Tetris bento grids, editorial typography, structured 1px border dividers, and high-clarity white/sand surfaces with deep navy accents.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.transitions: Explicit property transitions only (e.g. transition-colors duration-200, transition-transform duration-200), never transition: all.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.contrast: Ensure slate-900 on #FAF9F6, slate-700 on white cards, amber-800 on warm amber pill tags.
